The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a user-agnostic prior in the latent space of VAE models is not always optimal, and the incorporation of user-specific information can be beneficial for recommendation tasks.
incorporating the user-specific information into the VAE latent space improves the quality of recommendation, and that this can be done in a principled way using the variational inference framework.
